title: Normalized completion models for the fixed integral closed presentation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ with $\ell$ invertible in $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$, in independent scheme and coefficient universes. There exist a coefficient calculus $S$ and its coherence [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], an ordinary model $M$ and a derived model for this same $S,M$ [def-trf-completion-unit-models], such that $S.\mathrm{integralClosed}=(\mathrm{IntegralOnSlice.duality}\ \ell\ E\ W\ \mathrm{none}).\mathrm{closed}$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].

proof.text: Map the global-section unit into each residue field and choose the coherent calculus with its integral closed presentation fixed. Choose the ordinary model separately, without changing that calculus.

proof.text: Use the termwise limit comparison with its actual projections, constant-limit unit with its K-injective normalization, and normalized constant Roos comparison from the canonical-model construction. Its system unit is the existing systemLimitUnit composite, so its composition equation is reflexivity. Keep the integral closed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalIntegralCompletionModels (hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(W, ⊤))) :
    ∃ (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
      (_coherence : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E W S)
      (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W),
      Nonempty (CompletionUnit.DerivedModel l E W S M) ∧
        (IntegralOnSlice.duality l E W none).closed = S.integralClosed
